passage: The museum's newest exhibit features dozens of maps drawn by sailors in the Pacific Islands, whose charts made of sticks and shells ______ ocean swells rather than coastlines, an approach that allowed navigators to cross thousands of miles of open water.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
steps: The clause “whose charts…______ ocean swells” needs a main verb for “charts.”
“Representing,” “to represent” and “having represented” can't serve as the clause's verb.
key: Every clause needs a finite verb; -ing forms and infinitives alone can't do the job.
